policy.boosting: margin/total models, 80 iterations, learning_rate 0.05, seven leaves, depth 3, min_samples_leaf 40, l2 10, no random early-stopping split
policy.complexity: encoded features include missing indicators; rank and Ridge effective df audited; tree leaves are not comparable linear parameter counts
policy.elastic: joint score-target MultiTaskElasticNet, l1_ratio 0.5, max_iter 10000, tol 1e-6
policy.guards: score MAE <= control +0.05, total MAE <= control +0.10, margin gain >=0.05
policy.median: separate 0.5-quantile margin/total regressions, alpha 0.1, HiGHS solver
policy.parsimonious: one bootstrap standard error above best eligible MAE; prefer linear, fewer fitted active encoded features, stronger Ridge, then fixed family/profile order
policy.promotion: no automatic forecast change or untouched-holdout claim
policy.refresh: same season-locked choice; refit on strictly available outcomes at each forecast
policy.selection: preceding two completed NFL seasons; early-week margin MAE; lock before first early forecast
policy.standard_error: 2000 season-week block resamples, seed 20261014; descriptive selection heuristic
